drivers.title: Installation Operations and Security - Pacific Resilient Distributed Air Basing
drivers.description: Increase provides funding to support the ability of Pacific Air Forces (PACAF) to support operational activities across the Indo-Pacific theater. The funding will be used to meet Secretary of Defense, INDOPACOM, and PACAF posture initiatives by enabling fighter, bomber, mobility, and Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance operations across the western Pacific. These operations ensure the right capabilities are in the right places at the right time to deliver Integrated Deterrence towards our adversaries in the Pacific. Additionally, the funding improves PACAF's ability to operate in conjunction with Sister Services, the Interagency, and Coalition partners by enabling unique scenarios to improve warfighting advantages.

drivers.title: Installation Operations and Security - Base Defense
drivers.description: Increase for the one-time programmatic change supports Air Base Defense and Resiliency programs worldwide. Resourcing will bolster Air Base Resiliency specifically through the fielding of the Rapid Airfield Damage Recovery (RADR) Family of Systems (FoS) inclusive of the Rapid Explosive Hazard Mitigation (REHM) and Rapid Damage Repair (RDR). REHM purchases include Clearance Blade Assemblies (CBAs) that are specialized attachments for front-end loaders designed to quickly push Unexploded Ordnance (UXO) and other hazards off of airfield surfaces without causing detonations or additional damages. Funding for RDR purchases include consumable and non-consumable crater repair materials as well as other supplies such as Inclement Weather Kits, Light Carts, Tool Trailers, Water Skids, Spall Repair Kits, and Airfield Marking Kits. This funding also provides Security Forces Squadrons increased training and equipment including Readiness Training at Regional Training Centers, Tactical Radios, Joint Light Tactical Vehicle equipment and sustainment, Security Forces weapons and training, and centrally-funded Tactical and Cold Weather equipment. Finally, funding will resource sustainment of Air Force European Contingency Air Operations Set (ECAOS).

drivers.title: Command and Control Support Activities - Rhombus Guardian
drivers.description: Increase to the Rhombus Guardian program provides additional support for user interface and user experience configuration, iterative feature development, unlimited licenses/seats, software interface refinement and continual validation, model development and refinement. Rhombus Guardian is a digital platform used for Air Force's future force design module to accelerate the change required to optimize the contribution to Joint All Domain Operations. This decision-making tool helps the Air Force make enterprise force structure decisions using machine learning. Increase also supports backend data storage for Rhombus Guardian after a break in funding due to technical error in the database.

Forces are trained and organized to employ ACE concepts and are equipped with light/lethal materiel to provide C2 in a contested environment.

Funding was used to support OCIE including body armor, first aid kits, load carriage, and other personal protective equipment.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Average Workyear Cost Adjustment
drivers.description: Increase in Civilian Personnel compensation adjusts average workyear costs. Each year, Air Force uses detailed execution and cost factor analysis to update civilian compensation costs for the purpose of accurately forecasting budget estimates for the civilian workforce. The Subactivity Group average cost adjustment is a result of these cost changes as well as updated pay raise, awards and benefit assumptions.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Full-time Prevention Workforce
drivers.description: Increase provides half-year funding and manpower (223 FTEs) to implement the Independent Review Commission's (IRC) recommendations on sexual assault in the Military as directed in the 22 September 2021 Secretary of Defense memo "Commencing DoD Actions and implementation to Address Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment in the Military". Provides for career billets for military justice personnel, implementing optimum full-time prevention workforce, provides personnel to enable the phased elimination of collateral duty for Sexual Assault Prevention Response victim advocates.

drivers.title: Service-wide Activities - Contracting-Information Technology
drivers.description: Increase supports fielding of new capabilities which enable Department of the Air Force to create automated and efficient contracts for the operational and weapon systems contracting communities. Funds accelerate deployment of Contracting-Information Technology (Con-IT), a modernized contract writing solution to consolidate legacy systems while meeting compliance and auditability requirements. Additional technical expertise is required to support cloud migration and deployment to disconnected and classified systems.

drivers.title: AF Energy Program - Climate Impact Improvement
drivers.description: Increase funds upgrades to installations, infrastructure, and aircraft to improve operational energy efficiencies. Funds support carbon footprint assessments to identify energy savings opportunities at installations. Funds enable the development and execution of installation energy alternative financing contracts, the construction of net zero building pilots, and reduction of water waste. Aircraft efficiencies include implementation of winglets on KC-135, KC-46, and C-17 existing aircraft; improved engine foam wash; vertical pallet stackers for cargo aircraft; the research of aircraft drag reduction efforts; and the expansion of the Mission Execution Excellence Program (MEEP).

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Halt True North
drivers.description: Decrease reduces full-year funding and manpower (48 FTEs) to halt program growth of the Vice Chief of Staff of the Air Force True North Program which embeds mental health, physical and religious providers at the group and squadron level.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Workforce Redesign
drivers.description: Increase provides full-year funding and manpower in Mobilization Preparedness (Subactivity 21D $7,250, 51 FTEs), Administration (Subactivity Group 42A $1,737, 15 FTEs) and Other Service Wide Activities (Subactivity Group 42G $6,151, 53 FTEs) to support medical contingency positions to maintain the right workforce balance at the lowest cost.

drivers.title: Service-wide Support - Army & Air Force Exchange Service Military Clothing
drivers.description: Increase of funds supports the Military Clothing Sales (MCS) Program, which is the official source of military uniforms and accessories. Funding addresses user requirements through integration of lifecycle capabilities to deliver safe, state of the art equipment to the Warfighter at 86 stores world-wide, and is critical to properly equipping 502K Active Duty, National Guard, and Reserve Airmen. MCS stores are the primary means by which Airmen and Space Professionals obtain the uniform items required to perform their in-garrison, training and deployed military duties.

drivers.title: Defense Finance and Accounting Service - Program Increase
drivers.description: Increase to Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS) funding to support the Air Force for accounting and financial processing workloads, data storage costs for the General Accounting and Finance System and Integrated Accounts Payable System, and Enterprise Funds Distribution system management. DFAS serves as the processing center for defense commercial invoices.

drivers.title: Sexual Assault Prevention and Response and Victim Support - Case Management System
drivers.description: Increase accelerates fielding of the Office of Special Investigations (OSI) Records, Investigations, and Operations Network (ORION). ORION is a cloud-based mobile case management system (CMS) that will replace the two legacy Information Technology systems used by the Air Force to record and report criminal investigation and criminal activity information. The Air Force seeks to modernize its current investigative case management systems to more effectively, efficiently, and accurately capture, record, and report data related to criminal investigations and criminal activities including sex-related and intimate partner violence offenses. ORION increases transparency and reduces Air Force risk related due to its ability to index, document, and process criminal history.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Medical Manpower
drivers.description: Increase provides full-year funding and manpower (5 FTEs) to support medical administration support positions to maintain the right workforce balance at the lowest cost.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency Programming Correction
drivers.description: Decrease removes full-year funds and manpower (-3 FTEs) to correct a system issue that resulted in a duplicate programming entry in a prior year transfer from the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA).

drivers.title: Civil Air Patrol - Grant Funding
drivers.description: Decrease in funding following one time increase provided in P.L. 117-328, FY 2023 Consolidated Appropriations Act for grant funding in order to improve Civil Air Patrol Corporation's capacity to achieve its congressionally mandated mission.

drivers.title: Civil Air Patrol - Adjustment
drivers.description: Decrease in funding as a result of price adjustments due to prior year grant funding increases.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel & Operation Inherent Resolve - Precision Attack Combat Forces
drivers.description: Decrease in combat support travel and per diem for precision attack combat forces in support of Operation Enduring Sentinel and Operation Inherent Resolve which in line with the current U.S. Central Command theater posture.

drivers.description: Decrease based on updated program acquisition strategy and revised program estimates.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - U.S. Air Force Civilian Workforce Reduction
drivers.description: Decrease full-year funding and manpower (87 FTEs) due to the challenges in the current recruiting and retention environment. U.S. Air Force recognizes the staffing challenges for the civilian workforce given alternative and often more flexible opportunities from the private sector in competition for a decreasing pool of eligible talented candidates in the post-pandemic job market. This results in the inability to meet the civilian personnel hiring targets. Consequently, U.S. Air Force will reduce civilian compensation and manpower to reflect a more realistic execution plan for FY 2025 and will continue to develop strategies to grow the workforce to the levels necessary to support the National Defense Strategy.

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - F-35 Beddown
drivers.description: Decrease in funding to right-size beddown costs supporting the footprint for ten combat coded bases and one aggressor squadron across eight locations (Lakenheath, Madison, Montgomery, Ft. Worth, Tyndall, Jacksonville, Eglin and Nellis).

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - B-21 Program
drivers.description: Decrease supports reduction to contracted Site Security Managers (SSMs) due to reduced Military Construction requirements. These SSMs are needed to supplement site access controls, implement screening and inspection procedures, as well as monitor construction and personnel in accordance with the Construction Security Plan (CSP). Additionally, the reduction is due to a decrease for systems engineering, software coding and program management personnel at the B-21 software maintenance facility at Tinker Air Force Base.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - European Deterrence Initiative - Precision Attack Combat Forces
drivers.description: Decrease in combat support travel and per diem for precision attack combat forces in support of the European Deterrence Initiative which is in line with the current European Command theater posture.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Accelerate F-15E Divestment
drivers.description: Decrease full-year funding and manpower (5 FTEs) for the accelerated divestment of the F-15E aircrafts.

drivers.description: Increase in half-year funding and manpower (2 FTEs). U.S. Air Force depot level manpower requirements are commensurate with the restoration of B-1s per readiness directive.

drivers.description: Decrease due to divestiture of EQ-4B and RQ-4B Block 40 aircraft and ground segments.

drivers.description: Decrease reflects a reduction to operations support programs to properly align financial resources with critical capabilities needed in cyber, weapons system sustainment, medical accounts and the flying hour program.

drivers.title: Command and Control - Joint Training

drivers.title: Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) Combat Enhancement - Long Endurance - Airborne ISR
drivers.description: Increase in funds acquires four ULTRA platforms, with an associated electro-optical/infrared sensor and signals intelligence package for each, to perform integration and testing of an engine upgrade, and to execute an associated overseas operations assessment of the system's ability to contribute to 96 hours per day of multi-sensor Long Endurance - Airborne Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance (LE-AISR) over Afghanistan.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Full-Time Equivalent and Average Workyear Cost Adjustment
drivers.description: Decrease in Civilian Personnel compensation adjusts Full-Time Equivalent and average workyear costs. Each year Air Force uses detailed execution and cost factor analysis to update civilian compensation costs for the purpose of accurately forecasting budget estimates for the civilian workforce. The Subactivity Group average cost adjustment is a result of these cost changes as well as updated pay raise, awards and benefit assumptions.

drivers.title: Combat Communications - Agile Communications
drivers.description: Increase in funding supports AF Force Generation through the Agile Combat Employment (ACE) concept by outfitting 5th-generation fighter Units and lead wings with standardized capabilities across the total force providing organic command and control (C2) and mission generation at deployed and austere locations. ACE is the Air Force's plan to project power from competition through conflict as a subset of adaptive operations. Funds provide communication fly away kits, small communication packages of existing expeditionary communication forces and adds new communications capabilities.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel - ISR Combat Enhancement
drivers.description: Decreases funds in ISR combat enhancement in support of Operation Enduring Sentinel and Operation Inherent Resolve. This change impacts MQ-9 UAV equipment maintenance contracts and is in line with the current U.S. Central Command theater posture.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - European Deterrence Initiative - Command and Control
drivers.description: Decreases funds in command and control in support of the European Deterrence Initiative. This primarily impacts equipment maintenance for wargaming and simulation centers and is aligned to the current European Command (EUCOM) theater posture.

drivers.title: Special Operations Forces - Joint Terminal Attack Control Qualification Training
drivers.description: Increase in funding supports Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC) requirements for the Tactical Air Control Party (TACP) weapon system. Funding supports temporary duty travel to air ranges and joint exercises for JTAC currencies, qualifications, and upgrade training, to improve overall JTAC production and combat mission readiness rates, as well as complex training to succeed against advanced adversaries. Furthermore, the increase in funding provides the equipment required for the Department of Defense’s transition to Joint All Domain Command and Control (JADC2) to support the National Defense Strategy.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - European Deterrence Initiative - ISR Combat Enhancement
drivers.description: Decreases funds for command and control in support of the European Deterrence Initiative. This change impacts equipment maintenance for the MQ-9 UAV and is aligned to the current European Command (EUCOM) theater posture.

drivers.title: Command and Control - E-7A Training
drivers.description: Increase funds training costs incurred while partnering with the Royal Australian Air Force to train U.S. aircrew and maintenance personnel on the E-7A Wedgetail. This training partnership is the first step in establishing the foundation for operations and maintenance of the E-7A weapons system. Additionally, it strengthens strategic partnerships in the USINDOPACOM region while increasing future interoperability.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel - Personnel Recovery
drivers.description: Decreases funds in AMC Channel passenger flights for combat rescue and recovery in support of Operation Enduring Sentinel. This change is in line with the current U.S. Central Command theater posture.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Inherent Resolve - Personnel Recovery
drivers.description: Increase funds personnel recovery in support of Operation Inherent Resolve. This supports travel and airlift for personnel recovery in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility and realigns funding from Operation Enduring Sentinel to the Operation Inherent Resolve based on historical requirements.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Project PHALANX
drivers.description: Decrease half-year funding and manpower (13 FTEs) to phase-in manpower for Project PHALANX over 5-years instead of 3-years as previously planned. The adjustment properly aligns programming with execution-year challenges regarding the current recruiting and retention environment. OP32 101 Executive General Schedule

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Tactical Air Control Party Career Field Reduction
drivers.description: Decrease removes half-year funding and manpower (9 FTEs) in line with reductions to the Tactical Air Control Party career field. OP32 101 Executive General Schedule

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Accelerated HH-60G Divestment
drivers.description: Decrease removes full-year funding and manpower (5 FTEs) for the accelerated divestment of HH-60G aircraft. OP32 101 Executive General Schedule

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Divestiture of Joint Surveillance and Target Attack Radar System
drivers.description: Decrease removes full-year funding and manpower (3 FTEs) for the divestment of Joint Surveillance and Target Attack Radar System. OP32 101 Executive General Schedule

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Studies and Analysis Program
drivers.description: Increase half-year funding and manpower (2 FTEs) to enhance the U.S. Air Force Analysis Working Group for the support of the Studies and Analysis program. Manpower will evaluate long-term impact of changes to training and curriculum of courses to enhance command decisions and make predictions for U.S. Air Force's resource requirements while combining essential modeling, optimization, and scheduling environments.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Combat Rescue Helicopters
drivers.description: Increases half-year funding and manpower (2 FTEs) for the restoration of 10 Combat Rescue Helicopters supporting U.S. Air Force mission of global personnel recovery.

drivers.title: Readiness Training - Adversary Air
drivers.description: Decrease in funding accelerates the reduction of the aggressor offset for the contract Adversary Air (ADAIR) program.

drivers.title: Readiness Exercises - Pacific Exercises and Readiness Training
drivers.description: Decrease in funding following a Fiscal Year 2024 increase for Pacific Air Forces (PACAF) sponsored exercises and theater exercises.

drivers.title: Readiness Ranges - Advanced Radar Threat System-Variant (ARTS-V3) Beddown
drivers.description: Decrease in funding following a requested Fiscal Year 2024 increase for preparation activities on the ranges supporting ARTS-V3. (Nevada Test and Training Range; Joint Pacific Alaskan Range Complex; Utah Test and Training Range; and Wallops Island/Tyndall). ARTS-V3 will establish a long range, high power surface-to-air missile radar simulator.

U.S. Air Force recognizes the staffing challenges for the civilian workforce given alternative and often more flexible opportunities from the private sector in competition for a decreasing pool of eligible talented candidates in the post-pandemic job market. This results in the inability to meet the civilian personnel hiring targets. Consequently, U.S. Air Force will reduce civilian compensation and manpower to reflect a more realistic execution plan for FY 2025 and will continue to develop strategies to grow the workforce to the levels necessary to support the National Defense Strategy.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - European Deterrence Initiative - Readiness Exercises
drivers.description: Decrease funds for readiness exercises in support of the European Deterrence Initiative. This training and exercise programmatic adjustment accounts for a decrease in scheduled exercises for the European Command (EUCOM) theater in 2025.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel - Readiness Training & Exercises
drivers.description: Increase funds for readiness exercises in support of the Operation Enduring Sentinel. This training increases pilot readiness and survivability by training with dedicated and tailorable sorties. This change increases funding to be in line with the current U.S. Central Command theater posture.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Classified Decrease
drivers.description: Decrease to Classified Program. Details will be provided under separate cover by the Office of the Secretary of Defense Special Access Program Central Office to properly cleared individuals on a need-to-know basis.

drivers.description: Increase in Civilian Personnel compensation adjusts average workyear costs. The Subactivity Group average cost adjustment is a result of these changes as well as updated pay raise, awards and benefit assumptions.

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Operations - B-52
drivers.description: Increase due to significantly higher operational demand primarily impacting engine and Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) spares requirements across B-52 program due to relevancy and priority of platform. The-B-52 is a long-range, heavy bomber that can perform a variety of missions and can carry nuclear or precision guided conventional ordnance with worldwide precision navigation capability. It will continue to be upgraded to maintain lethality and readiness in support of Nuclear Deterrence Operations (NDO) mission execution until the B-21 is fielded.

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - A-10
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in requirements for A-10 Programmed Depot Maintenance (PDM), specifically in Scheduled Structural Inspection (SSI).

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - KC-135
drivers.description: Increase due to higher KC-135 operational demand impacting engine and Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) spares requirements. This increased funding is also driven by higher labor rates and additional task hours for aircraft depot and heavy maintenance tasks. The KC-135 Stratotanker provides the core aerial refueling capability for the United States Air Force.

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - F-15E
drivers.description: Decrease due to the reduction in required F-15E Programmed Depot Maintenance (PDM) inductions as the result of some PDM inductions occurring earlier than projected to accommodate modification efforts.

drivers.title: Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) - Global Integrated ISR Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced requirements to support organic aircraft, engine and software maintenance. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include the Distributed Common Ground System (-$16,858), MQ-9 (-$12,091), U-2 (-$7,377), RQ-4 (-$5,706), and RC-135 (-$3,943). OP32 661 AF Consolidated Sustainment 930 Other Depot Maintenance

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - KC-46
drivers.description: Increase to KC-46 driven by an increase in depot labor rates and an accelerated aircraft induction schedule. The KC-46 supports the Rapid Global Mobility mission by providing all weather aerial refueling, cargo/passenger airlift, and aeromedical evacuation in support of tactical and strategic operations.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - F-22
drivers.description: Decrease in F-22 requirements due fewer projected Reversion inductions for low observable coating applications. Reversion is required as coatings deteriorate over time due to exposure to environmental conditions.

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - B-1
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in projected B-1 organic depot maintenance requirements.

drivers.title: Agile Combat Support - Common Support Equipment
drivers.description: Decrease in Common Support Equipment driven by decrease in contract repair and refurbishment of Noise Suppressors and fire suppression systems, and Engine Test Stands.

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Operations - B-2
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced requirements for B-2 depot level maintenance.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - F-15EX
drivers.description: Increase in F-15EX due to the inception of this new program into the WSS portfolio and the associated costs to support maintenance requirements. The F-15EX is an all-weather, extremely maneuverable, tactical fighter designed to permit the Air Force to gain and maintain air supremacy over the battlefield. It penetrates enemy defense and outperforms any current enemy aircraft.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - F-15
drivers.description: Decrease in requirements for contract F-15 engine overhaul.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-130J
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced heavy depot maintenance requirements.

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - HH-60W Combat Rescue Helicopter
drivers.description: Increase in requirements to perform depot-level Aircraft Condition Evaluation (ACE) inspections, which uncover defects requiring depot level repair. The HH-60W Combat Rescue Helicopter (CRH) Air Vehicle is a multi-engine, rotary wing aircraft with a primary mission of worldwide Personnel Recovery (PR)/Combat Search and Rescue (CSAR) in all intensities of conflict as well as during peacetime.

drivers.title: Command and Control - Command and Control Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced requirements in Command and Control Programs, to include Mission Planning Systems (-$6,275), Theater Air Control Operations (-$5,515 ), Battle Control System Fixed (-$4,882), Air Traffic Control and Landing System (-$1,511), and Link- 16 (-$1,334). OP32 661 AF Consolidated Sustainment 930 Other Depot Maintenance

drivers.title: Special Operations - Special Operations Forces
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in depot maintenance and overhaul requirements and a reduction in software costs based on lower estimated workload requirements. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include CV-22 (-$9,639), AC-130J (-$8386), and the MC- 130J (-$185).

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Air Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Increase due to higher costs in the testing and maintenance of software. Specific programs supported by this increase include GPS User Equipment ($3,839), Range Communications ($2,796), Tactical Training Operations ($2,506), Advanced Medium Range Air-to- Air Missile (AMRAAM) ($2,080), Common Support Equipment ($2,024), HARM Targeting System ($1,890), Avionics System Sustainment ($709), Tactical AIM Missile ($580), Precision Measurement Equipment Laboratory ($165), Compass Call ($163), Tactical Air Control Party ($134), and Base Level Communication ($29). The mission of Air Superiority programs is to conduct offensive and defensive operations to gain and maintain air superiority to enable the conduct of operations by United States forces.

drivers.title: Command and Control - E-3
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced software maintenance and engine overhaul requirements for the E-3 Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS). OP32 661 AF Consolidated Sustainment 930 Other Depot Maintenance

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Operations - Nuclear Deterrence Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduced software requirements and unserviceable engines in certain Nuclear Deterrence programs. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Minuteman III (-$6,834), Military Satellite Communications (-$1,569), Air-Launched Cruise Missile (-$755), and the Minimum Essential Emergency Communications Network (-$305).

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - F-16
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced F-16 software sustainment requirements for the Operational Flight Program.

drivers.title: Agile Combat Support - Agile Combat Support Programs
drivers.description: Increase due to cost increases in organic maintenance due to delayed acquisition and refurbish/repair efforts to maintain mandated War Reserve (WR) requirements. Specific programs supported by this increase include Replacement Vehicle Program ($8,824), Nuclear Weapons Support ($1,794), and Lean Equipment Program Initiative ($998). Agile Combat Support mission programs provide the warfighter with life-cycle management and war-ready support equipment and vehicles.

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - Global Precision Attack Programs
drivers.description: Decrease in Global Precision Attack Programs due to planned divestment efforts. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include WRM (-$5,219), Maverick Operations (-$3,852), F-16 (-$1,342), and Hellfire Missile Operations and Sustainment (-$275). OP32 661 AF Consolidated Sustainment 930 Other Depot Maintenance

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - HC-130J
drivers.description: Decrease to HC-130J due to reduced heavy depot maintenance requirements.

drivers.title: Space Superiority - Space Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in software requirements. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Military Satellite Communication (MILSATCOM) Terminals (-$5,724) and Family of Advance Beyond Line-of-Sight Terminals (FAB-T) (-$3,942).

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - Combat Rescue and Recovery
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced HH-60 block cycle changes driving a reduction in software requirements and a reduction in requirements for aircraft shipping and induction into Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group (AMARG) Storage.

drivers.title: Education and Training - Education and Training Programs
drivers.description: Increase for various pilot training platforms to include T-38, H-1, and T-6. The increase for T-38 ($4,177) supports J-85 Depot Level Engine Maintenance, Repair, Overhaul support requirements to include Reliability Centered Maintenance concepts for the T-38 training mission. The increase for H-1 ($3,961) is driven by increasing unit prices and additional contractor requirements. The increase for the T-6 supports Depot Level Maintenance (DLM) requirements. The T-38 Talon is a twin-engine, high-altitude, supersonic jet trainer primarily used for joint specialized undergraduate pilot training. The H-1 is used by the Air Force for its undergraduate helicopter pilot training track conducted at Fort Rucker, qualifying aircrew in all aspects of helicopter operations. The T-6 Texan II trains entry-level U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force student pilots in primary flying skills.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Air Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Decrease driven by the migration of Mission Planning Common Component (MPCC) software support from contractor based maintenance to organically based maintenance which produced an overall cost savings. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Combat Air Forces Training (-$6,907), Tactical AIM Missile (-$1,113), Miniature Air-Launched Decoy (-$593), and the HARM Targeting System (-$301).

drivers.title: Agile Combat Support - Agile Combat Support Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced organic workload requirements in multiple programs. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Mine Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) Family of Vehicles (-$2,795), Multi-platform Auto Test System Sustainment (-$2,140), Aircraft Storage (-$934), and Airbase Ground Defense (-$22).

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Operations - UH-1N
drivers.description: Increase driven by the number of Programmed Depot Maintenance (PDM) requirements based on fixed 8-year interval schedule. The UH-1N Huey provides airlift of emergency security and disaster response forces, medical evacuation, security surveillance of off-base movements of nuclear weapons convoys and test range areas during launch conditions.

drivers.title: Space Superiority - Space Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Increase in various Space Superiority programs driven by an increase in centralized software maintenance support and anticipated transition of Global Aircrew Strategic Network Terminal (ASNT) Increment 1 to sustainment. Specific programs supported by this increase are Family of Advance Beyond Line-of-Sight Terminals (FAB-T) ($4,032) and High-Altitude Electro-Magnetic Pulse ($943). These programs provide operational support for sustainment of Military Satellite Communications (MILSATCOM) and critical Nuclear Command and Communications (NC3) capabilities supporting POTUS, SECDEF, U.S. Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM) and other Combatant Commands (COCOMs), International Partners (IPs), and North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member countries.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - KC-10
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced sustainment requirements related to planned divestiture of KC-10 aircraft.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-5
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in C-5 trainer software updates needed.

drivers.title: Command and Control - Command and Control Programs
drivers.description: Increase to various Command and Control programs for organic depot software sustainment, development, and maintenance. Specific programs supported by this increase include Tactical Data Link ($2,114), Air Traffic Control and Landing Systems ($313) and Joint Surveillance System ($18).

drivers.title: Special Operations - MC-130J
drivers.description: Increase driven by higher labor rates to support aircraft depot and heavy maintenance tasks. The MC-130J conducts clandestine, or low-visibility, single or multi-ship, low-level infiltration, exfiltration, and resupply of US and allied special operations forces. Additionally, the MC-130J performs airdrop, air-land, and air refueling missions for special operations helicopters and tiltrotor aircraft intruding politically sensitive or hostile territories.

drivers.title: Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) - Weather Operations
drivers.description: Increase for hardware support of the Radio Solar Telescope Network, which is part the Air Force Weather Weapon System (AFWWS). As an integrated system of systems, AFWWS enables the joint warfighter to exploit timely, accurate, and relevant global environmental info to gain the advantage during military operations, directly supporting DoD operations at home station and deployed.

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Operations - E-4B
drivers.description: Increase for new software requirements. The primary mission of the E-4B is Strategic Command and Control, providing the President of the United States (POTUS), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (CJCS), and Secretary of Defense (SECDEF) a highly survivable command, control, and communications center to direct U.S. forces, execute emergency war orders and coordinate civil authorities’ activities.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-17
drivers.description: Increase due to higher demand for repairs to C-17 cartridge and propellant actuated device (CAD/PAD) components. The C-17 Globemaster III is capable of rapid strategic delivery of troops and cargo to main operating bases or directly to forward bases in the deployment area.

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - Combat Rescue and Recovery
drivers.description: Increase in requirements for depot repair support of Hand Held Radios (HHR) and associated equipment. Combat Rescue is the Combat Air Force’s effort to prepare for and execute recovery and reintegration of isolated personnel when engaged in conflict with a peer adversary.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-130J
drivers.description: Increase due to maintenance costs of the mission planning software for the C-130 Self-Contained Navigation System (SCNS), specifically the Agile Global Mobility (AGM) and Consolidated Airdrop Tool (CAT) software. The C-130J is the newest generation of the C-130 Hercules which primarily performs the tactical portion of the airlift mission.

drivers.title: Facilities Restoration and Modernization - B-21 Facilities
drivers.description: Increase to fund B-21 facility requirements for Building 9201 software sustainment lab at Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma. The building will support over 750 personnel providing organic depot support for the weapon system and is critical to enabling the program’s sustainment strategy. Additionally, funds five building renovations (B8305 28th Maintenance Group facility, B7520 28th Maintenance Squadron facility, B601 Propulsion Shop, B905 Non Destructive Inspection and Command Post) in support of the 1st Main Operating Base (MOB) at Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota.

drivers.title: Facilities Restoration and Modernization - Efficient Buildings, Energy Savings
drivers.description: Decrease adjusts funds within existing resources to conduct net zero (reduced carbon emissions) building pilots across the Department of Defense to comply with FY 2023 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) limitations. Prior year funds were used to accomplish this effort at the Child Development Center (CDC) at Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts.

drivers.title: Facilities Restoration and Modernization - Davis-Monthan Basing Action
drivers.description: Increase to fund increased operations at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Arizona. Funding supports facility restoration and modernization initiatives that will enable the additional Air Force Special Operations Command units and Air Combat Command units to achieve initial operating capability.

drivers.title: Facilities Sustainment
drivers.description: Decrease reflects a reduction to operations support programs to properly align financial resources with critical capabilities needed in cyber, weapons system sustainment, medical accounts and the flying hour program.

drivers.title: Facilities Restoration and Modernization - Critical Infrastructure
drivers.description: Decrease in funding following fiscal year 2024 increase to execute targeted demolition, restoration and modernization of failed or failing critical infrastructure to improve the overall condition of the Department's facility inventory.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Average Workyear Cost Adjustment
drivers.description: Increase in Civilian Personnel compensation adjusts average workyear costs. Each year, the U.S. Air Force uses detailed execution and cost factor analysis to realign and update civilian compensation costs and manpower for the purpose of accurately forecasting budget estimates for the civilian workforce. The Subactivity Group average cost adjustment is a result of these changes as well as updated pay raise, awards and benefit assumptions.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - U.S. Air Force Civilian Workforce Reduction
drivers.description: Decrease full-year funding and manpower (396 FTEs) due to the challenges in the current recruiting and retention environment. U.S. Air Force recognizes the staffing challenges for the civilian workforce given alternative and often more flexible opportunities from the private sector in competition for a decreasing pool of eligible talented candidates in the post-pandemic job market. This results in the inability to meet the civilian personnel hiring targets. Consequently, U.S. Air Force will reduce civilian compensation and manpower to reflect a more realistic execution plan for FY 2025 and will continue to develop strategies to grow the workforce to the levels necessary to support the National Defense Strategy.

drivers.title: Facilities Sustainment - DoD Military Working Dog (MWD) Program
drivers.description: Increase to begin deliberate and key investments to fund requirements that address the health and safety of Military Working Dogs (MWD), in compliance with DoD standards of care for clean and safe kennel facilities. Funds will used to mitigate climate impacts, noise conditions, and environmental risks at facilities on the MWD training campus at Lackland Air Force Base, Texas. The Department of the Air Force is the DoD’s Executive Agent for the MWD Program resourcing, training, utilization, and final disposition.

drivers.title: Facilities Sustainment - Real Property Asset Database
drivers.description: Decrease in funds to ensure appropriate funding is in place to maintain transferred facilities that are no longer being maintained by Operations and Maintenance resourcing in support of Real Property Unique Identifiers (RPUID) in the Real Property Asset Database.

drivers.title: Facilities Sustainment - Barksdale Air Force Base Facilities
drivers.description: Decrease in funding following fiscal year 2024 increase for facility upgrades at Barksdale Air Force Base, Louisiana. The upgraded facilities support Long Range Standoff Cruise Missile system Aircraft Monitoring and Control nuclear certification, including the nuclear warhead and B-52 aircraft, as well as Operational Test and Evaluation activities for Initial Operation Capabilities of Long Range Standoff Cruise Missile System.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - European Deterrence Initiative - Facilities Restoration & Modernization
drivers.description: Decrease funds for facilities restoration and maintenance in support of the European Deterrence Initiative. This maintenance decrease aligns to the current European Command (EUCOM) theater requirements.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Phased Attrition of Local National Indirect Hire
drivers.description: Decrease full-year funding and manpower (38 FTEs) to support the phase attrition of the Local National Indirect Hire positions while ensuring the U.S. Air Force maintains international commitment to the United Kingdom to avoid infringing on acquired rights regulations such as the Transfer of Undertakings Regulation 2006.

drivers.title: Facilities Sustainment - Infrastructure Investment Strategy Manpower Conversion
drivers.description: Decrease realigns full-year funding from nonpay to pay to support the infrastructure sustainment manpower conversion from Foreign Hires to U.S. Direct Hires within this Subactivity Group. Manpower will provide facility maintenance and repair activities in effort to implement the Secretary of the Air Force's Infrastructure Investment Strategy (I2S) initiatives to improve the overall conditions of facilities and restore infrastructure readiness across the enterprise.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Infrastructure Investment Strategy Manpower Conversion
drivers.description: Increase realigns full-year funding from nonpay to pay to support the infrastructure sustainment manpower conversion from Foreign Hires to U.S. Direct Hires within this Subactivity Group. Manpower will provide facility maintenance and repair activities in effort to implement the Secretary of the Air Force's Infrastructure Investment Strategy (I2S) initiatives to improve the overall conditions of facilities and restore infrastructure readiness across the enterprise.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel - Facilities Restoration, Modernization, & Sustainment
drivers.description: Decrease funds for facilities restoration and maintenance in support of Operation Enduring Sentinel. This program adjustment decreases equipment maintenance, facility rents, sustainment, and land costs to be in line with the current U.S. Central Command theater requirements.

drivers.title: Cyberspace Superiority - Cyberspace Superiority Support Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in labor, material, and overhead costs. Specific programs include Information Assurance (-$11,217), Cyber Command and Control Mission System (-$2,452), and Air Force Intranet Control (-$2,409).

drivers.title: Cyberspace Superiority - Air Force Cyber Defense
drivers.description: Increase in funding driven by new sustainment requirements for Industrial Control Systems (ICS). Specifically, protection against the Internet of Things (IoT), the implementation of an Intrusion Detection System (IDS), and Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) capability. Defensive Cyberspace Operation is a Cyberspace Superiority mission system that coordinates and executes resources needed to assess, analyze, and respond to AF network security incidents, intrusive activity, malicious logic, and vulnerabilities.

drivers.title: Cyberspace Superiority - Intrusion & Vulnerability Assessment
drivers.description: Increase due to higher requirements for operational maintenance support for system components including operating systems, web services, application maintenances, and coordination with separate development activities. Increase also due to higher weapon system hardware sustainment costs to include replacement items, support equipment, annual hardware warranties, removing decommissioned systems, and shipping repaired and repairable parts. Defensive Cyberspace Operation is a Cyberspace Superiority mission system that coordinates and executes resources needed to assess, analyze, and respond to AF network security incidents, intrusive activity, malicious logic, and vulnerabilities.

drivers.title: Cyberspace Superiority - Cyberspace Defense Analysis
drivers.description: Increase in funding driven by contract maintenance and modification services. The Cyberspace Vulnerability Assessment/Hunter (CVAH) Weapon System (WS) provides a precision capability to identify, characterize, and mitigate cyberspace threats impacting critical operational capabilities within Air Force and DoD Networks. The Cyberspace Defense Analysis (CDA) WS monitors, collects, analyzes and reports on information transmitted via unsecured telecommunications systems for Network Defense, operational security (OPSEC) and Force Protection.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - System Sustainment
drivers.description: Realignment within Subactivity Group 11V to transition System Sustainment from Overseas Operations Costs to Base. The specific group affected is CSI Software Maintenance ($8,105).

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - F-35
drivers.description: Increase due to higher demand and requirements for depot level reparables support. Higher operational tempo also impacted the Air Force cost share of the global operations support contract, along with software and lab sustainment requirements. The F-35A is the U.S. Air Force’s latest fifth-generation fighter. It will replace the U.S. Air Force’s aging fleet of F-16s and A-10s, which have been the primary fighter aircraft for more than 20 years, and bring an enhanced capability to survive in the advanced threat environment in which it was designed to operate.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-17
drivers.description: Increase due to higher operational demand driving additional Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) spares requirements and new CLS supported engine requirements. Additionally, the quantity of required overhauls has increased in FY 2025 to meet mandatory war readiness levels, in conjunction with cost increases in the unit overhaul price. The C-17 Globemaster III is capable of rapid strategic delivery of troops and all types of cargo to main operating bases or directly to forward bases in the deployment area.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - KC-10
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced sustainment requirements related to planned divestiture of KC-10 aircraft.

drivers.title: Global Integrated Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance - U-2
drivers.description: Decrease due to reductions in Sustaining Engineering (SE) and Programmed Depot Maintenance (PDM) requirements.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Air Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Increase supports requirements for system training and simulator operations and maintenance, as well as Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) to address obsolescence issues associated with aging weapons systems. Specific programs supported by this increase include HC-130 ($16,761), Miniature Air-Launched Decoy ($2,707), E-9 ($980), GPS user Equipment ($92), Electronic Warfare Equipment Sustainment ($7,609), and Multi-platform Avionics Systems Sustainment ($5,211).

drivers.title: Global Integrated Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance - RQ-4
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced Sustaining Engineering (SE) requirements and a reduced projection of Diminishing Manufacturing Sources (DMS) contract needs.

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence - Nuclear Deterrence Programs
drivers.description: Increase to support full workload transition from the Ground Subsystem Support Contract (GSSC) to the Ground Minuteman Automated Test System (GMATS) for Minuteman Operations. GMATS is used to verify functional requirements of 296 geographically separated Ground Facility components.

drivers.title: Command and Control - E-11A and E-3
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in Sustaining Engineering (SE) requirements and contractor support for Reliability, Maintainability, and Availability (RM&A) requirements for the E-11A (-$50,424) and E-3 (-$45,171).

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - VC-25
drivers.description: Increase to support Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) depot activities for Heavy Maintenance (HM) overhaul/repair/inspection requirements needed to maintain airworthiness certification for aircraft related to Very Important Person Special Airlift Mission (VIPSAM), which provides Mission Communications Systems Sustainment on Operational Support Aircraft/Executive Airlift.

drivers.title: Global Integrated Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance - Global Integrated ISR Programs
drivers.description: Increase due to software sustainment licensing requirements and Sustaining Engineering (SE) support for Form, Fit, Function (F3) and Reliability, Maintainability & Availability Engineering (RM&A). Specific programs supported by this increase include Distributed Common Ground System ($51,159) and the Network Centric Collaborative Targeting (NCCT) system ($639).

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - Global Precision Attack Programs
drivers.description: Increase due to additional costs in software maintenance and licenses, Sustaining Engineering (SE) tasks required to maintain currency, and costs for Other Major End Items (OMEI), as well as costs for initializing the Weapons System Evaluation Program (WSEP). Specific programs supported by this increase include Tactical Air Control Party ($37,909), Advanced Targeting pods (Lightening/Sniper) ($3,362), F-117 ($423), Ammunition Operations ($4,627), Small diameter bombs ($2,091), and Maverick (AGM- 65) ($414). These programs support the Global Precision Attack mission which includes strategic attack, interdiction, close air support and prompt global strike.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Range Communications
drivers.description: Decrease due to the implementation of a cross-domain and encryption solution for the P5 Combat Training System (P5CTS).

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - F-16
drivers.description: Decrease to requirements at the F-16 Training Systems Support Center due to obsolescence issues, unrepairable projectors and image generators, and reductions in F-16 Sustaining Engineering (SE) and Technical Order (TO) support.

drivers.title: Education and Training - T-1
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in requirements and lower contract costs for operational Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) material and support for flying operations.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - F-22
drivers.description: Increase driven by operational requirements for engine and Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) spares, as well as increases to Unscheduled Depot Level Maintenance and Contractor Management Support on the F119 engine. The F-22 Raptor combines stealth, supercruise, maneuverability, and integrated avionics, coupled with improved supportability, representing an exponential leap in warfighting capabilities. The Raptor performs air-to-air and air-to-ground missions allowing full realization of operational concepts vital to the 21st century Air Force.

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - HC-130
drivers.description: Increase in Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) requirements for engine overhauls driven by the Rolls-Royce propulsion contract that supersedes Mission Care, which performs all scheduled and unscheduled repairs, maintenance actions, restoration, and sustainment modifications. The increase also supports growth within CLS management and the Sustaining Engineering (SE) inclusion of Condition Based Maintenance Plus (CBM+) tasks. The HC-130J replaces HC-130P/Ns as the only dedicated fixed-wing Personnel Recovery platform in the Air Force inventory.

drivers.title: Special Operations - Special Operations Programs
drivers.description: Increase in Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) requirements for engine overhauls driven by the Rolls-Royce propulsion contract that supersedes Mission Care, which performs all scheduled and unscheduled repairs, maintenance actions, restoration, and sustainment modifications. Specific programs supported by this increase include MC-130J ($19,873) and AC-130J ($12,754). MC-130J Commando II aircraft conduct infiltration, exfiltration and resupply of US and allied special operations forces in direct support of unified and theater special operations commands and U.S. Special Operations Command (SOC) contingencies in hostile and denied territory. AC-130J Gunship conducts Air Strike and Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance of U.S. and allied Special Operations Forces in direct support of unified and theater Special Operations Commands and U.S. Special Operations Command contingencies.

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - B-1
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in contract and engineering services supporting B-1 structural programs.

drivers.title: Command and Control - Command and Control Programs
drivers.description: Increase supports contract engineering analysis to resolve supportability challenges due to obsolescence, material shortages, additional workload/costs for depot-level hardware sustainment activities, and software sustainment activities to correct faults, maintain performance, and adapt to evolving technical requirements within the Command and Control mission set. Specific programs supported by this increase include Battlefield Airborne Communications Node (BACN) Ground Stations ($14,281), Theater Air Control Operations ($7,998), Talon Archer ($3,383), Deployable Radar Approach Control ($2,280), Battle Control System ($671), Air Traffic Control and Landing System ($616), Joint Surveillance System ($449), and Tactical Data Link ($309).

drivers.title: Global Integrated Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance - RC-135
drivers.description: Increase to support programmed fuel bladder replacement beginning FY 2025 and significant increase in operational demand driving increased engine overhauls. The RC-135 reconnaissance aircraft supports theater and national level consumers with near real time on-scene intelligence collection, analysis and dissemination capabilities.

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - A-10
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in A-10 Aircrew training systems support based on planned divestitures. This includes cancellation of the High Resolution Display System production/installment and additional reductions in Electronic Warfare System training, technical order support, and systems engineering software.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - F-15EX
drivers.description: Increase to support the fielding of the new F-15EX. The F-15EX is an all-weather, extremely maneuverable, tactical fighter designed to permit the Air Force to gain and maintain air supremacy over the battlefield.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - F-15
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced requirements based on the planned divestment of the F15C/D fleet. A portion of requirement has shifted to F-15E and F-15EX in FY 2025. Contract Field Team requirements were also removed.

drivers.title: Agile Combat Support - Agile Combat Support Programs
drivers.description: Increases in Sustaining Engineering (SE) and technical orders (TO) requirements to include deficiency reports and mishap investigations requiring engineering analysis & support to ensure the appropriate configuration control of legacy tech orders. Specific programs supported by this increase include Common Support Equipment ($12,661), Lean Equipment Program Initiative ($5,595), Basic Expeditionary Airfield Resources (BEAR) ($171) and MRAP ($74). Agile Combat Support programs provide our Nation's warfighters and allies world-class life-cycle management on sustainment of war-ready Support Equipment & Vehicles.

drivers.title: Education and Training - T-6
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in engine overhaul requirements.

drivers.title: Agile Combat Support - Aerial Targets
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in Sustaining Engineering (SE) requirements for F-16 and drone peculiar spare parts and equipment. This includes engineering studies and laboratory analysis to determine safety of aircraft structures and systems.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Compass Call Operations
drivers.description: Increase driven by continued fielding of EC-37B fleet and correlated costs for Programmed Depot Maintenance (PDM), as well as higher storage costs for the EC-130H prior to planned divestment. The EC-130H is an airborne tactical weapon system that employs a modified version of the C-130 Hercules airframe; the EC-37B is a next-generation, tactical jamming platform tasked with the disruption of enemy C3, radar, and navigation - both aircraft support the Compass Call mission set.

drivers.title: Global Integrated Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance - Weather Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in Next Generation Weather Radar (NEXRAD) requirements after completion of a 8-year Service Life Extension Program (SLEP) program and CLS-provided depot level maintenance. This decrease also accounts for the divestment of the Joint Environmental Toolkit (JET).

drivers.title: Command and Control - Command and Control Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced Sustaining Engineering (SE) efforts, reduced requirements for engineering analysis on the FPS-124 radar equipment, and reduced requirements to evaluate and update baseline system software. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Networks and Information Integration (NII) programs (Link16) (-$6,566), Air Traffic Control and Landing Systems (ATCALS)(- $2,574), Atmospheric Early Warning System (AEWS) (-$1,045), Wide Area Surveillance (-$875), Deployable Instrument Landing system (-$557), and Battle Management Command Control Center (-$310).

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - DV Airlift
drivers.description: Decrease is due to the reduced price of the new Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) contract for the C-40 (-$9,521) and the reduction of one interior refresh for the C-32 (-$2,266).

drivers.title: Education and Training - T-38
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced requirements for operational Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) material and support.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Air Dominance Programs
drivers.description: Increase for Sustaining Engineering (SE) projects to address parts obsolescence and sustainment activities and ensure components remain safe, reliable and continue to meet requirements. Specific programs supported by this increase include AIM-9 missile ($463), AIM-9X missile ($978), and the HARM Targeting System (HTS) ($9,300).

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence - Nuclear Deterrence Programs
drivers.description: Decrease in Sustaining Engineering (SE) for depot-level repair and maintenance engineering support, Test & Evaluation engineering support, cybersecurity requirements, and overall Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) activities. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Minimum Essential Emergency Communications Network (-$4,349), Worldwide Joint Strategic Communications (- $3,479), Air Launched Cruise Missile (-$1,609), B-2 Operations (-$462), H-1 Minuteman Support Operations (-$427), and Mobile Consolidated Command Center (MCCC) (-$288).

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence - B-52
drivers.description: Decrease reflects the current planned and projected obsolescence efforts. Historical requirements included technical refreshes of the weapon system trainer (WST) and cockpit procedures trainer (CPT), but were postponed due to the delay in the Combat Network Communication Technology (CONECT), Delta Merge, and B-52 Software Block 07 efforts.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - Rapid Global Mobility Programs
drivers.description: Increase to depot maintenance and Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) spares for Reliability, Maintainability, and Availability (RM&A) improvements driven by higher operational demand which directly impacts maintenance schedules. Specific programs supported by this increase include C-21 ($7,669), Halvorsen Loader ($682), C-12 ($22), and Executive Airborne Communications Support ($148).

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-17 LAIRCM
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in support requirements for software maintenance and long-term sustainment efforts for Large Aircraft Infrared Countermeasures (LAIRCM) depot test stations including Automated Test Equipment (ATE) and associated instruments, software, fixtures, and support equipment.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - KC-135 Stratotanker
drivers.description: Decrease is due to conversion schedule slowdown in FY 2024, which lowers the conversion requirements in FY 2025.

drivers.title: Space Superiority - Space Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Increase in Sustaining Engineering (SE) requirements to provide engineering support for the Global Aircrew Strategic Network Terminal (ASNT) Increment 1 Engineering Development Model (EDM) and production terminals, which includes the analysis and investigation of issues involving systems interfaces, networks, protocol or diagnostic problems identified by the Warfighter. Specific programs supported by this increase include Presidential National Voice Conferencing (PNVC) ($3,699), High-altitude Electro-Magnetic Pulse (HEMP) ($1,565) and Satellite Communications (SATCOM) Terminal Operations ($338). These programs provide operational support for sustainment of Military Satellite Communications (MILSATCOM) and critical Nuclear Command and Communications (NC3) capabilities supporting POTUS, SECDEF, U.S. Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM) and other Combatant Commands (COCOMs), International Partners (IPs), and North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member countries.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - C-37
drivers.description: Increase to support the addition of one aircraft full interior refurbishment that was deferred from prior years, as well as an increase in the aircraft depot inspection packages. The C-37A/B are twin-engine, turbofan aircraft acquired to fill the worldwide special airlift missions for high ranking government and Department of Defense officials.

drivers.title: Air Superiority - Air Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced mission requirements for engine, system training, and maintenance Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) for certain programs. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Multi-platform Engine Sustainment (-$2,407), Advanced Medium Range Air-to-Air Missile (-$1,749), HARM (-$335), and Service-Wide Support (-$110).

drivers.title: Education and Training - T-7A Advanced Pilot Training System
drivers.description: Increase to support the new T-7A Red Hawk trainer. The T-7A Red Hawk is an all-new advanced pilot training system designed for the U.S. Air Force and will replace the T-38.

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - Combat Rescue and Recovery Programs
drivers.description: Increase due to higher costs in Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) Management Support driven by increased labor rates and material escalation, which is required to maintain Operational Availability and Authority to Operate. Specific programs supported by this increase include Combat Survival/Evader Locator ($3,566) and HH-60W ($473).

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - F-15E
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction of organic Programmed Depot Maintenance and the offload whole engine repair contract, as well as reduction in F-15 Training Systems contractor support.

drivers.title: Personnel Recovery - HH-60G
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduced engineering support required to provide corrective data for deficiencies not covered in technical data.

drivers.title: Education and Training - Pilot Training Programs
drivers.description: Increase due to new contract pricing in Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) services consisting of program management, support equipment maintenance, technical manual maintenance, subscriptions, technical support, planning and scheduling, deployment support, security and safety of the U.S Air Force Academy (USAFA) Program. The USAFA program trains, motivates, inspires, and prepares the next-gen of combat aviators. Specific programs supported by this increase include Undergraduate Flight Training ($2,966) and H-1 Training ($80).

drivers.title: Cyberspace Superiority - Cyberspace Superiority Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in requirements for High Frequency Global Communication System (HFGCS) ground station antenna systems as part of scheduled depot maintenance and software licensing for the Theater Deployable Communication.

drivers.title: Agile Combat Support - Agile Combat Support Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to reduction in Sustaining Engineering (SE) efforts and a reduction in direct labor cost associated with maintaining the currency and configuration control of Technical Order (TO) data. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Multi-platform Auto Test Systems Sustainment (-$2,173) and Nuclear Weapon Support (-$439).

drivers.title: Global Precision Attack - Global Precision Attack Programs
drivers.description: Decrease due to a reduction in Sustaining Engineering (SE) and hardware and software requirements. Specific programs reflecting a decrease include Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile (JASSM) ($1,653), Training Munitions/Equipment ($483), and Hellfire Missile ($13).

drivers.title: Space Superiority - Family of Advance Beyond Line-of-Sight Terminals (FAB-T)
drivers.description: Increase in requirement due to anticipated transition of Global Aircrew Strategic Network Terminal (ASNT) Increment 1 to sustainment, as well as a rise in FAB-T Sustaining Engineering (SE) requirements. This increase provides hardware maintenance and support that consists of fault detection & isolation, repair/certification for FAB-T Terminals, test equipment, test stations, Test Program Sets (TPS), and adaptors for existing test equipment. These programs provide operational support for sustainment of Military Satellite Communications (MILSATCOM) and critical Nuclear Command and Communications (NC3) capabilities supporting POTUS, SECDEF, U.S. Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM) and other Combatant Commands (COCOMs), International Partners (IPs), and North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member countries.

drivers.title: Special Operations - CV-22
drivers.description: Decrease in overall costs of the Over and Above (O&A) contract requirements.

drivers.title: Rapid Global Mobility - Tunner Loader
drivers.description: Decrease due to the reduced scheduled depot overhauls (teardown and rebuild) of the Tunner Loader.

drivers.title: Combat Air Forces
drivers.description: Decrease to Combat Air Forces (CAF) flying hours supporting air forces that are directly engaged in combat operations. Examples include fighter, bombers, command and control, combat search and rescue, and intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance aircraft. The CAF flying hour program reflects a net decrease in program funding and an increase of 44,546 hours. Included in this overall increase is a realignment from OOC to Base of 46,153 hours. The net increase to program funding is due to an increase in price in the cost per flying hour elements (i.e. fuel, parts, and supplies). Each year Air Force uses detailed execution and cost factor analysis to update civilian compensation costs for the purpose of accurately forecasting budget estimates for the civilian workforce. The Subactivity Group average cost adjustment is a result of these cost changes as well as updated pay raise, awards and benefit assumptions.

drivers.title: COCOM Service Support to Other Nations - Exercise Support
drivers.description: Increase for United States Southern Command (USSOUTHCOM) exercise plan. Funding supports personnel travel and airlift operations in support of Joint Chiefs of Staff directed USSOUTHCOM theater exercises with partner and other nations.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel - COCOM Service Support to Other Nations
drivers.description: Decrease funds for COCOM service support to other nations in support of Operation Enduring Sentinel.

drivers.title: International Activities
drivers.description: Increase reflects minor adjustment to overall mission support activities.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - European Deterrence Initiative - International Activities
drivers.description: Decrease funds for international activities in support of the European Deterrence Initiative.

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - F-35 Operational Beddown
drivers.description: Increase funds the expansion for F-35 operational beddown requirements to support the ongoing delivery of new weapon systems, new operating locations and unit standup. Funding supports beddown requirements such as: operational site improvements and setup; simulator facilities and integration into the Joint Simulation Environment; advanced travel pods; deployable debrief facilities; and other furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E). The combination of late basing decisions, late MILCON funding availability, and delayed contracting actions are compressing F-35 beddown timelines at new operating locations, which necessitates increased Operation and Maintenance funding to support stopgap measures called Interim Operating Procedures (IOPs). These IOPs are required to maintain operational capabilities while awaiting permanent facilities and drive additional FY 2026 costs, such as temporary facility modifications, increased TDY requirements for off-station training, and contractor support for surge requirements at sites preparing for First Aircraft Arrival (FAA).

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - INDOPACOM Rotational Deployments
drivers.description: Increase funding to provide resources for rotational fighter aircraft deployments for heightened theater posture in support of the INDOPACOM Operation plan. The funding provides the requisite operation and maintenance resources to bridge the gap and sustain a rotational Air Superiority presence as the F-15Cs divest, while the squadrons reconstitute with F-15EXs as the aircraft come off the production line.

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - Bomber Deployments
drivers.description: Increase provides resources to support the deployment of bomber aircraft. In FY 2026, this funding will support the temporary relocation (deployment) of Air Force Global Strike Command B-1 bombers from Ellsworth AFB, SD to Grand Forks, ND due to the temporary runway closure at Ellsworth necessitated by the B-21 Beddown runway upgrades, a project which is anticipated to continue into FY

drivers.title: Enhanced Theater Force Posture
drivers.description: Increase funding to provide necessary resources for theater posture in support of geographic combatant commander requirements. Funds the necessary operation and maintenance resources to sustain ongoing operations, support enhanced in-theater force protection requirements and maintain deterrence activities. In this Subactivity Group, funds operational support costs to include logistics, essential equipment, SAAM airlift and deployment travel expenses associated with the broader increased tempo and mission requirements in priority theaters.

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Combat Forces - Realign Sentinel Funding
drivers.description: Increase funds shortfalls in the operational sustainment to the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD) Squadrons, further supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of the nation's strategic deterrent capabilities. Funds have been internally realigned within the U.S. Air Force to support near-term operation and maintenance sustainment shortfalls due to the schedule delays in the Sentinel program. This increased support will allow for better allocation of funds and help reduce discrepancies in daily operational activities, ultimately ensuring smoother and more efficient operations for our nuclear enterprise as the Air Force bridges to a future in the delayed Sentinel program.

drivers.title: Overseas Operations Costs - Operation Enduring Sentinel (OES)
drivers.description: Decrease funds for Precision Attack Combat Forces requirements in support of Operation Enduring Sentinel (OES). This supports the five air bases in USCENTCOM and aligns to the current theater requirements.

drivers.title: Air Superiority Combat Forces - F-22 Training Support Squadron Relocation
drivers.description: Increase to support the movement of the 1st Training Support Squadron (1 TRSS) from Tyndall AFB, FL to Langley AFB, VA and includes the F-22 Formal Training Unit Mission Training Centre breakdown, storage, movement and install at its new location at Joint Base Langley-Eustis. Additionally, funding will provide beddown support of the Langley Low Observable Composite Repair Facility (LOCRF) for simulator instructors, communications equipment and other associated furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E).

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Combat Forces – UH-1N and MH-139 Helo’s
drivers.description: Increase for operational requirements of the UH-1N and MH-139 helicopters and restores baseline funding for the UH-1 maintenance contract that was removed prior to the MH-139 program slippage. This increased support will allow for better allocation of funds and help reduce discrepancies in daily operational activities, ultimately ensuring smoother and more efficient helicopter operations.

drivers.title: Nuclear Deterrence Combat Forces - NC3 Sustainment
drivers.description: Increase supports Nuclear Deterrence Combat Forces that maintain Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) priorities due to changes in requirements, modernizing sustainment and security operations, and the overall NC3 enterprise due to an continually- evolving threat.

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - Thunderbirds
drivers.description: The increase supports Thunderbird F-16 Squadron to maintain its day-to-day operations and prepare for an expanded schedule of 34 events per season, as set by the Secretary of the Air Force/Public Affairs (SAF/PA). To accommodate this increased schedule, the squadron will require additional airlift support, which will involve either two C-130s or one C-17, along with associated equipment and personnel, resulting in a 45% increase in costs.

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - Air and Missile Defense Capabilities
drivers.description: Increase funds to support emerging multi-domain sensors capable of detecting, tracking and identifying critical threats across the air domain. Expands the capabilities to include Ground-to-Air Transmit and Receive (GATR) requirements in support of NATO, joint and nuclear command, control and communications operational mission sets.

drivers.title: Civilian Pay - Efficiency - Workforce Optimization
drivers.description: Decrease funding and manpower (137 FTEs) to optimize the workforce in compliance with Executive Order 14210, "Implementing the President's Department of Government Efficiency Workforce Optimization Initiative."

drivers.title: Precision Attack Combat Forces - B-2 Squadrons
drivers.description: Increase funds for B-2 readiness that supports mission planning, low observable capability and T-38 trainer aircraft maintenance. Mission risk if not supported is falling short on qualified pilots and stealth capability needed for B-2 fleet.

drivers.description: Increase to Special Access Classified Program. Details will be provided under separate cover by the Office of the Secretary of Defense Special Access Program Central Office to properly cleared individuals on a need-to-know basis.
